pass_clause_text: - **Pass.** The same operational pass as `ext-20260928`, plus no HTTP 429:
- **Anything else** is recorded as `needs_attention` or failed, with its reason.
frozen_acceptance.next_trial_rule_text: - **When the next trial may start:** only after the previous trial passed or recovered, with no 429 in any of its attempts. The last start is 18:30 ET.
stop_rule_text: a preflight refusal other than benchmark quote age;
six benchmark refusals in a row;
a scan with no fired symbol;
frozen_acceptance.evaluation: A trial is pass only if every clause holds: engine status passed or completed_no_signals; flat; end reconciliation cash_match and positions_match true; 0 open orders; totals.pnl_consistent true; execution_stats.duplicate_executions 0 and no unexplained broker/ledger difference in the broker reconciliation; ledger_risk.halted_reason null at the trial's end; no HTTP 429 in the receipt's HTTP observations, no transport rate_limited mark and no non-200 scan page. A trial with a failed clause is needs_attention when the engine itself reported needs_attention, and fail otherwise; a clause the files cannot evaluate is recorded as null, and a trial whose verdict rests on such a clause would be inconclusive. The verdict ignores what the engine or the driver printed.
frozen_acceptance.paper_compare: not run: decision 11 makes it acceptance evidence only after the tool is checked against b528bb55 receipts; no paper_compare output exists in the series directories
known_effects_text: - **#215 part 2 and the run-loop stall are open.** Sparse after-hours quotes can freeze the transport, so a residual can stay open overnight. Account separation keeps any residual off account 1.
- **#486.** Recovery exits each held symbol on its own fresh quote, and its ports wait only on the benchmark (SPY) quote within the 15 s start timeout. This is unmeasured at the broker after hours.
frozen_acceptance.boundary_disposition_text: - **Boundary disposition.** Each trial ends flat with 0 open orders. A residual that after-hours quotes cannot clear stays open and is recorded; `recover` runs again at the next pre-market or at the open (#215 part 2, open).

iova_refusal_analysis.what_is_recorded: the ledger marks rec-ext-20260929-4-0000002 transport_proven_not_sent (runner.py:1110-1125), and the recover receipt records only the exception type SubmissionNotSent (recovery.py:22-24). The transport raises SubmissionNotSent('submission prevented before HTTP request') for any exception in its submit hooks (the budget hook and then the wire guard) and for a deferred budget (transport.py:804-818), so the refusal reason itself is not recorded.
iova_refusal_analysis.discriminator: request_budget (safety.py:1299-1311) inserts the request row and sets submit_attempted=1 in one transaction, or returns a delay without writing only when the prior 60 s hold 150 requests or 130 submits. The IOVA intent has submit_attempted 0 and no request row; the ledger's last request is the BEX sale's submit at 17:10:09.024 ET, and the 60 s before the IOVA reservation hold 0 requests. So the submission never reached a reservation.
excluded_by_the_files: the per-minute request and submit caps (150 and 130): 0 requests in the prior 60 s cannot defer (runner.py:846-858); from the recover command's recovery_started to the refusal the ledger holds 4 reads and 1 submit
the transport wire guard (transport.py:1173-1179, bound as before_send at transport.py:1062): it runs only after the hook returns a durable reservation, and there was none
the order-contract gates (transport.py:205-213): they raise OrderContractRefused, recorded as order_contract_refused, not transport_proven_not_sent
the transport's not-ready refusal (transport.py:1414-1416): it precedes the ledger reservation, and the intent was reserved

the recovery's own exit-budget guard (recovery.py:139-149): a refusal there ends the recovery as recovery_quote_not_fresh or recovery_deadline_reached (recovery.py:238-250), not SubmissionNotSent; about 50 s of the 120 s deadline remained against a 20 s whole exit

validate_pending's other checks for a sell (safety.py:862-915): the session was open (the recovery checks it before each exit), the sell window runs 600 s from the recovery start, 1 order was outstanding against 20, 68 shares were held against 68 pending, and it checks no price bound for a sell; _refresh_risk (safety.py:752-766) only latches halts
not_excluded_by_the_files: validate_pending's quote check (quote_not_fresh, safety.py:658-662): the IOVA quote was 0.021 s old at the reservation (ledger mark 17:11:14.023 ET), but the refusal's time is not recorded, so its age at the check is unknown
the transport's 0.25 s deadline for the submit hook on the owner loop (transport.py:1148-1167), whose TransportError the transport sanitizes the same way
iova_refusal_analysis.conclusion: The files cannot distinguish these two.

limitations: Metadata plus broker-reconciled evidence, not a frozen gate run. It qualifies no gate.
The broker read uses the same broker API and account as the engine, so it is independent of the engine code but not of the broker.
Alpaca paper fills are simulated by the broker from quotes. They are not exchange executions and do not establish live slippage, queue position or partial-fill behaviour.
Mechanics only: the protocol's development study passed 0 of 768 rule-exits, so no result here evaluates a strategy.
paper_compare.py was not run (decision 11: the tool is not checked against b528bb55 receipts), so no historical fill-model comparison is recorded.

The engine logs carry no timestamps, so websocket and stream-gap lines cannot be placed in time. An isolation check on 2026-09-23 (trials/20260923b-needs-attention) found normal-close restart lines only after the engine's stop(); these runs neither confirm nor rule that out.

Account designation: the series kept its own engine ledger (the new account-2 root, shared with pre-20260929) but traded broker account alpaca-paper-2, which blueprints/us-equities/incentive-monitor/forward-protocol-v1.json:63 and docs/secret-storage.md:17 designate as the isolated incentive-monitor study account. Whether this use fits the forward study's isolation is referred to the forward protocol's owner, the trading lane; this receipt does not decide it.

The IOVA refusal's reason is not recorded: the transport sanitizes it and the recovery keeps the exception type. The files narrow it to validate_pending's quote check or the 0.25 s hook deadline and cannot distinguish the two.
The trigger of trials 2 and 3's controller_stop is not recorded; a data-stream disconnect is consistent with it but inferred, not measured.
The 2026-09-30 09:08Z ledger snapshot predates the 06:00 ET recovery attempts, so their 0 orders rest on the 17 attempt receipts and the console, not on the ledger.
Fees: the broker posted REG, TAF and CAT fees for 2026-09-29 on account 2, for pre-20260929 and this series together. The engine has no fee model, so no figure here includes them.
The residual's final disposition is pending (residual_recovery_20260930); the coordinator fills it in after the engine fee fix and its recovery.
evidence_note: Built from the private series workspace (the engine's own receipts, consoles, logs and events), a read-only snapshot of account 2's mover ledger, the systemd user journal, git show b528bb55 and the frozen clone's sources, and the coordinator's two read-only broker reconciliation runs (GET only, paper endpoint), whose stdouts are committed here. Figures present in two or more of those sources were cross-checked by assertion, and a mismatch stops the build; field_provenance names the rest. No credential, account id, account number, account fingerprint, broker order id or ref, activity id, execution id or host path is recorded.
